Name: Custom Ore Procession JsonAssets
Author: EvilWish995
Description:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/JrbURRo.png[/img]
Welcome,
This is my first Asset Pack for Stardew Valley.

[size=4][b]What comes with it?[/b][/size]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/7ttsKK3.png[/img]

[Producers]
- Crusher [Left in Picture]
- Ore Washer [Middle in Picture]
- Blast Furnace [Right in Picture]
- Cutton Stretcher

[Plants buyable by Pierre]
- Fine Coal Seeds -> Fine Coal -> Is Required in Crusher, Ore Washer and the Blastfurnace
- Fine Copper Seeds -> Fine Copper -> Needs to be Refined *
- Fine Iron Seeds -> Fine Iron -> Needs to be Refined * 
- Fine Gold Seeds -> Fine Gold -> Needs to be Refined *
- Fine Iridium Seeds -> Fine Iridium -> Needs to be Refined *

- Cutton Seeds -> Fine Cutton -> Can be Refined into Cloth at the Cutton Stretcher
- Green Love -> Plant Hearts -> Currently [WIP]

[size=3][b]Ok but where can I buy the machines?[/b][/size]

For the Ore Processing ones you go to Clint wait I show you -> 
[img]https://i.imgur.com/aQSSZUA.png[/img]

[b]Wait a second this is not English is the mod in German?
[/b]
No, I change it to English on upload! BTW sorry for my bad English ^^

So for the Cotton Stretcher you go to Robin it is the Last in the List

So and for the Seeds you go to Pierre's shop.

[b]Have you one example how to process the Ores?[/b]

Sure I have made it on an image, so you can, it better understand ; )

[img]https://i.imgur.com/7DQFEjt.png[/img]

[b]Ok thanks but how I install this?[/b]

Oh, that's really easy go to your Mod Folder and unzip the .rar yeah that's it, because you must install the dependencies JSON Assets and Producer Framework.

So that is my first content pack I will work on it and add more useful Content to it.
Leave Feedback in the Command Section Thanks <3

Have a nice Day,
Evil Coding
